name: run_ledger_window_edge_open_position
description: A position stays open across the end of the replay window: the final snapshot marks it at the last MARK, nothing is force-closed and no exit fee is invented.
derivation: initial wallet 1000. AAA mult=1. FILL +1 @50 fee_rate=0.0005 slip=5: sign=+1; exec=50*(1+5/1e4)=50*1.0005=50.025; fee=1*1*50.025*0.0005=0.0250125; wallet=999.9749875; entry=50.025; mark=fill price 50; u=1*(50-50.025)=-0.025; equity=999.9499875. MARK 60: u=60-50.025=9.975; equity=999.9749875+9.975=1009.9499875. MARK 55 (last event, end of window): u=55-50.025=4.975; equity=999.9749875+4.975=1004.9499875. Position is still +1 at the end: no closing fill, so fees_cum stays 0.0250125 and wallet 999.9749875. Final: wallet 999.9749875, unrealized 4.975, equity 1004.9499875, realized 0, fees 0.0250125, funding 0, position +1. A forced close at 55 would add realized 4.975 to wallet and a fee, giving a different wallet; expected wallet pins no forced close.
